Implement class TransactionalMap(initial=None), with get(key, default=None), put(key,value), delete(key), begin(), commit(), rollback(). Changes are visible immediately. delete of a missing key is a no-op. Nested transactions are supported: committing an inner transaction retains its changes, but rolling back its outer transaction must undo them. commit/rollback with no active transaction raise RuntimeError. Mutating the map must not mutate the initial dict. Standard library only.

Implement evaluate(expression) returning fractions.Fraction. Parse unsigned decimal integer literals, ASCII whitespace, parentheses, binary + - * /, and unary +/-. Standard precedence, left associativity for binary operators, arbitrary consecutive unary signs. Reject any other characters, empty expressions, missing operands, implicit multiplication, or unmatched parentheses with ValueError. Division by zero raises ZeroDivisionError. Do not use eval, exec, ast, or third-party packages.

Implement strongly_connected_components(graph). graph maps string nodes to lists of directed outgoing neighbors. Include neighbor-only nodes and ignore duplicate edges. Return every strongly connected component as a sorted list of node names, with the outer list sorted lexicographically. Do not mutate graph. Empty graph returns []. Standard library only; graph traversal should be O(V+E), excluding output sorting.
